user_query: I'm searching for a tool that can generate documents automatically and also centralize document retention. Can you suggest a tool that can fulfill these requirements?

TaskList.description: Research document generation tools that automatically create documents based on user-defined templates.
Research document retention tools that provide centralized storage and management of documents.
Compare the features and user reviews of the identified document generation and document retention tools.
Provide suggestions for tools that meet both requirements of document generation and retention based on the comparison.
